meta.title: 你炒的菜全是水？因为从开火第一步就错了
meta.title_en: Why Is Your Stir-Fry All Watery? The Mistake Starts at the Burner
meta.topic: 家常菜 · 调料下锅时机科学

scenes.context: 炒不出饭店味不是手艺差，是放调料的时间全反了；大火炒时倒蚝油等于给全家炒苦味素。
sentences: 炒不出饭店那味，不是你手艺差，是放调料的时间全反了。
Your cooking isn't lacking skill — your seasoning timing is all backwards.
seasoning timing（调料时机）
同样的盐、同样的酱油，放早一秒肉变柴。
Same salt, same soy sauce — one second too early and the meat turns tough.
tough（柴的）
大火炒时倒蚝油，等于给全家炒苦味素。
Adding oyster sauce on full fire is cooking bitterness into every dish.
oyster sauce（蚝油）
scenes.speak: Your cooking isn't lacking skill — your seasoning timing is all backwards. Same salt, same soy sauce — one second too early and the meat turns tough. Adding oyster sauce on full fire is cooking bitterness into every dish.

scenes.title_en: The Physics: Hot Wok, Cold Oil
scenes.context: 美拉德反应需要 140 度以上；热锅冷油让锅底超 200 度，蒸汽膜带来不粘不糊的莱顿弗洛斯特效应。
sentences: 美拉德反应：蛋白质和糖在高温下生成几百种香味分子。
The Maillard reaction: protein and sugar brew hundreds of aroma molecules at high heat.
Maillard reaction（美拉德反应）
饭店火力是你家的三到六倍。
A restaurant burner runs three to six times hotter than yours.
burner（灶头）
热锅冷油：锅烧到冒烟再倒油，锅底温度超 200 度。
Hot wok, cold oil: heat until smoking, then add oil — the surface passes 200°C.
smoking（冒烟）
食材悬浮在蒸汽膜上，不粘锅、不糊底。
Food floats on a steam film — nothing sticks, nothing burns.
steam film（蒸汽膜）
paraphrase: Food rides on a cushion of steam.
scenes.speak: The Maillard reaction: protein and sugar brew hundreds of aroma molecules at high heat. A restaurant burner runs three to six times hotter than yours. Hot wok, cold oil: heat until smoking, then add oil — the surface passes 200°C. Food floats on a steam film — nothing sticks, nothing burns.

scenes.context: 盐靠渗透压抽干肉里的水；肉变色放、青菜出锅放、煲汤最后 15 分钟放。
sentences: 盐会把肉细胞里的水硬生生抽出来。
Salt yanks the water right out of the meat cells.
yank out（硬抽出来）
你不是在炒肉，你是在给肉做脱水。
You're not cooking the meat — you're dehydrating it.
dehydrate（脱水）
肉变色了、表面蛋白质凝固了，再放盐。
Salt only after the meat changes color and the surface proteins set.
set（凝固）
青菜要出锅前几秒钟才放盐。
Greens only get salt seconds before they leave the wok.
greens（青菜）
paraphrase: You end up boiling, not stir-frying.
scenes.speak: Salt yanks the water right out of the meat cells. You're not cooking the meat — you're dehydrating it. Salt only after the meat changes color and the surface proteins set. Greens only get salt seconds before they leave the wok.

scenes.context: 生抽要高温沿锅边激发酱香；老抽中途加管色；蚝油味精鸡精怕热，出锅前放。
sentences: 生抽管鲜，必须高温激发，沿锅边淋下去。
Light soy is for freshness — hit it with high heat along the wok's rim.
light soy（生抽）
老抽管色，红烧肉的酱红色全靠它中途加入。
Dark soy is for color — the braised-pork gloss comes from adding it mid-cook.
dark soy（老抽）
蚝油味精鸡精怕热，出锅前放，余温翻两下就够。
Oyster sauce, MSG, and chicken powder fear heat — add before serving; residual warmth is plenty.
residual warmth（余温）
scenes.speak: Light soy is for freshness — hit it with high heat along the wok's rim. Dark soy is for color — the braised-pork gloss comes from adding it mid-cook. Oyster sauce, MSG, and chicken powder fear heat — add before serving; residual warmth is plenty.

scenes.context: 葱姜蒜先姜再蒜最后葱；醋分烹醋与点醋；干粉类各有时间点；水淀粉临出锅才勾。
sentences: 葱姜蒜的顺序：先姜、再蒜、最后葱。
The order of aromatics: ginger first, garlic next, scallion last.
aromatics（葱姜蒜等香料）
醋分两次：热油烹醋为了香，出锅点醋为了酸。
Vinegar goes in twice: a splash in hot oil for aroma, a drizzle at the end for tang.
splash（烹/飞溅入锅）
水淀粉一定出锅前快速搅，汤汁瞬间浓稠。
Slurry goes in seconds before serving and is stirred fast — the sauce thickens instantly.
slurry（水淀粉）
大厨不是天赋异禀，他只是把规则背熟了。
Chefs aren't born gifted — they just memorized the rules.
gifted（天赋异禀的）
paraphrase: A final drizzle to keep the sour alive.
The sauce coats every piece like a jacket.
scenes.speak: The order of aromatics: ginger first, garlic next, scallion last. Vinegar goes in twice: a splash in hot oil for aroma, a drizzle at the end for tang. Slurry goes in seconds before serving and is stirred fast — the sauce thickens instantly. Chefs aren't born gifted — they just memorized the rules.

practice.q: 「放调料的时间全反了」英文怎么说？
practice.a: Your seasoning timing is all backwards.

practice.q: 「菜悬浮在蒸汽膜上」怎么翻译？
practice.a: Food floats on a steam film.
fear heat / high heat kills their umami.

pitfalls: Salt the meat before it hits the wok.
Salt only after the meat changes color and the surface proteins set.
Osmosis drags water out of raw meat — it turns dry and tough.
Add oyster sauce on full fire.
Add it just before serving; residual warmth is enough.
MSG over 120°C turns to pyroglutamate — umami becomes bitterness.
Drop food into a cold wok.
Heat the wok until smoking before adding oil.
Under 140°C the Maillard reaction never starts, so you steam the food dry.
Stir it in seconds before serving.
Starch sinks and clumps — you get a lumpy paste you can never stir apart.
shifts: 调料一股脑全下、锅不热就炒、蚝油当底油
按化学性质安排每样调料的下锅时机，热锅冷油打底
difficult_words: Your seasoning timing is all backwards.
The Maillard reaction brews hundreds of aroma molecules.
Food floats on a steam film.
Salt yanks the water out of the meat.
Stir the slurry in just before serving.
Ginger first, garlic next, scallion last.
footer_notes: 原视频为一支 5 分半的炒菜调料时间线教学，英文为场景意译，适合跟读练习厨房与科学表达。
